js: 'The Chat at a Firefox sidebar width (chat-plane design §9.10): New chat in the narrow head, New chat following the open thread folder (an ongoing folder making its new current conversation), the way back to the ongoing conversation and its marks in the list, and a message origin under its bubble. Headless Chrome with the dashboard navigation hidden, so the Chat has the viewport: 338 and 280 CSS px at --dsf 1.25, then a wide window. SETUP: a dev instance with the fake-echo alias (scripts/chat-actions-setup.sh). Wipes every chat thread and folder of that instance first. Run: scripts/ui-drive.py scripts/drive/chat-sidebar-head.json --dsf 1.25 --size 338x760 --shots DIR --token <owner token> --base http://<addr>.'

(() => { window.__setup = null; const j = async (u, b) => (await fetch(u, {method: b === undefined ? 'GET' : 'POST', headers: {'content-type': 'application/json'}, body: b === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(b)})).json(); const say = async (t, b) => (await fetch('/chat/api/threads/' + t + '/send', {method: 'POST', headers: {'content-type': 'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify(b)})).text(); (async () => { const f = await j('/chat/api/folders'); for (const x of f.folders) await j('/chat/api/folders/' + x.id + '/delete', {threads: 'delete'}); const t = await j('/chat/api/threads?archived=all'); for (const x of t.threads) await j('/chat/api/threads/' + x.id + '/delete', {}); const kai = await j('/chat/api/folders', {name: 'Kai', defaults: {model_alias: 'fake-echo'}}); await j('/chat/api/folders/' + kai.id, {ongoing: {idle_minutes: 0}}); const cur = await j('/chat/api/folders/' + kai.id + '/current', {new: true}); await say(cur.thread.id, {content: 'hello Kai'}); const work = await j('/chat/api/folders', {name: 'Work', defaults: {model_alias: 'fake-echo'}}); const w = await j('/chat/api/threads', {model_alias: 'fake-echo', kind: 'chat', folder_id: work.id}); await say(w.id, {content: 'a question about this page', origin: 'Typed in Kai\u2019s sidebar in Firefox, beside the tab \u201cExample Domain\u201d (https://example.org/).'}); localStorage.setItem('lmgw.sbh', JSON.stringify({kai: kai.id, kaiThread: cur.thread.id, work: work.id, workThread: w.id})); window.__setup = 'ok'; })().catch(e => { window.__setup = 'failed: ' + e; }); return 'setting up'; })()
